read.en: Broadcom fell 2.0% on Nov 4 to $325.48, trading between $321.74 and $334.12. It is below the falling 5-day ($330.18), 10-day ($331.91), 30-day ($345.05), 100-day ($369.09) and 200-day ($367.44) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 2 and below zero, histogram small at −0.41; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($350.45), and RSI is 42.

The high of $334.12 stalled at the $333–335.7 resistance and the close slipped under the $326.6 Nov 3 low; the $319.3–321.9 support held. Resistance is $326.6–331.9 (Nov 3 low, 5 and 10-day), then $334.1–335.7 (Nov 4 and Nov 3 highs) and $338.8–341.1. Support is $319.3–321.9 (Oct 22–23, Oct 30 and Nov 4 lows), then $314.1–316.3. A close above $331.9 would target $334–336; below $319.3, $314–316.
